newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stockholm stock exchange, OM reject merger for now.
newsitem.headline: Stockholm stock exchange, OM reject merger for now.

text.p: The Stockholm Stock Exchange AB and futures exchange OM Gruppen AB said on Wednesday conditions were not right at the moment for their planned merger.

The Stockholm Stock Exchange said in a separate statement an evaluation done in connection with merger negotiations valued the stock exchange at more than one billion crowns at the end of 1996 or about 700 crowns per share.
"Following some discussions the boards in the Stockholm Stock Exchange AB and the OM Gruppen AB have established that the conditions for a merger were not right," the two said in a joint statement.
They said they would look into alternative solutions to exploit the advantages they both see in a closer coordination of the companies' marketplaces and Information Technology (IT) resources.

The two, which are both listed companies, had been in talks since November aimed at creating a common Swedish market for equities and derivatives trading in response to growing competition among European financial centres.
